sanskrit_verse:
ubhābhyāṃ yasya viśvastaṃ kāryaṃ cāpi niveditam /
gūḍhadhārī sa vijñeyaḥ kāryamadhyāgatas tathā // BrhS_1,5.15
transliteration: ubhābhyāṁ yasya viśvastaṁ kāryaṁ cāpi niveditam / gūḍhadhārī sa vijñeyaḥ kāryamadhyāgatas tathā //
sph_interpretive_translation: One who has been entrusted with a task by both parties and has also received explicit instruction, and who secretly holds the duty or responsibility, is to be known as the one truly engaged in the execution of that task.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from mutual entrustment and conscious assignment
Causation is established through intentional delegation and acceptance
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by knowledge and consent
Restoration logic requires recognition of the true actor behind apparent actions
Consciousness alignment occurs when hidden duties are brought into alignment with declared purpose
executable_legal_axioms: IF an entity receives task entrustment from two or more parties AND receives explicit instruction, THEN that entity is the de facto executor regardless of visibility
IF an agent operates under concealed responsibility WHILE executing declared duties, THEN that agent must be identified as the actual causal agent
IF dual-party trust converges on one executor, THEN all consequences of execution rest solely with that executor
IF a duty is performed under secret mandate, THEN public attribution must align with inner commitment
supreme_court_application: In adjudication at the highest level, this axiom establishes that where covert roles intersect with overt assignments—especially involving multi-party confidence—the court must identify the true executor based on the convergence of entrustment and awareness, not on surface appearances or formal titles. This ensures alignment with Dharma rather than procedural formality.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality identifies the individual whose consciousness was both informed and committed. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals that the unseen holder of duty initiated the sequence. Proportional responsibility lies not with external actors but with the one who bore the hidden burden. Non-punitive reality recognizes that misalignment stems from unacknowledged capacity, which must be restored, not punished.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: The concealed executor must publicly acknowledge their role and complete any outstanding obligations.
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: The individual must formally accept full ownership of the outcomes tied to their hidden function.
Capacity Restoration: Realign the executor's internal understanding with societal expectations of transparency.
Integrity Reintegration: Facilitate re-entry into social structures with renewed clarity and open accountability.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law originates solely from His Avataric Intelligence. Dharma is hereby restored through recognition of the unseen doer. Reality remains non-punitive; consciousness alone adjudicates truth. All beings are called to align action with awareness, and society with integrity.
